title: 元知识详解：形式逻辑与证明 — Day 61

questions.question: 告警规则的条件是「所有节点都健康」。它的逻辑否定是什么？
options: 存在至少一个节点不健康
存在至少一个节点是健康的
没有任何节点是健康的
questions.explanation: 对全称量词取否定，要把 ∀ 换成 ∃ 并否定谓词：¬∀x 健康(x) ≡ ∃x ¬健康(x)。「所有节点都不健康」是最常见的错误，它把否定放错了位置，强得多也窄得多。
questions.question_en: An alert rule's condition is 'all nodes are healthy.' What is its logical negation?
options_en: At least one node is unhealthy
At least one node is healthy
No node at all is healthy
questions.explanation_en: Negating a universal swaps ∀ for ∃ and negates the predicate: ¬∀x healthy(x) ≡ ∃x ¬healthy(x). 'Every node is unhealthy' is the classic mistake: it misplaces the negation and makes a far stronger, narrower claim.

questions.question: 下面哪个说法是对哥德尔不完全性定理（及其在计算理论中的姊妹结论）的正当推论？
options: 既然有真而不可证的命题，科学结论就都不可靠，只能依靠信仰与直觉
它证明了人脑必然胜过任何机器，因为人能看出机器证不了的真理
不存在能检测出任意程序全部 bug 的万能工具，这是数学限制而非工程不足
给系统补上足够多的新公理，最终就能证明所有真命题并达到完备
questions.explanation: 停机问题与莱斯定理表明程序的非平凡语义性质不可判定，所以不存在万能验证器，实践里才要靠测试、类型、形式化验证的组合拳。定理只对形式系统内的可证性发言，推不出「科学不可靠」或「人脑胜机器」；加公理只会冒出新的不可证真命题。
questions.question_en: Which of the following is a legitimate inference from Gödel's incompleteness theorems (and their sibling results in computability theory)?
options_en: Since some truths can't be proven, all scientific conclusions are unreliable and we must rely on faith and intuition
It proves human minds must beat any machine, because people can see truths a machine can't prove
No universal tool can find every bug in arbitrary programs, a mathematical limit and not an engineering shortfall
Adding enough new axioms to the system will eventually let it prove every true statement and become complete
questions.explanation_en: The halting problem and Rice's theorem show that non-trivial semantic properties of programs are undecidable, so there's no universal verifier and practice relies on a mix of tests, types, and formal methods. The theorems speak only to provability within formal systems; they don't imply science is unreliable or that minds beat machines, and adding axioms just yields new unprovable truths.

questions.question: 在命题逻辑的实质蕴含下，「如果月亮是奶酪做的，那么 2+2=5」这句话的真值是什么？
options: 真，因为前件为假时蕴含恒为真
假，因为它的后件 2+2=5 在算术上为假
无法确定，因为前后件毫无关联
无真值，因为它构成了自指悖论
questions.explanation: 实质蕴含 P→Q 只在 P 真而 Q 假时为假，前件为假时整句恒真，这就是「假前提能推出任何结论」。它与日常说的「因果性如果」是两回事，所以前后件有没有关联不影响真值；这句话也不涉及自指。
questions.question_en: Under material implication in propositional logic, what is the truth value of 'If the moon is made of cheese, then 2+2=5'?
options_en: True, because an implication with a false antecedent is always true
False, because its consequent, 2+2=5, is arithmetically false
Undetermined, because antecedent and consequent are unrelated
No truth value, because it forms a self-referential paradox
questions.explanation_en: Material implication P→Q is false only when P is true and Q is false, so with a false antecedent the whole statement is true; this is why a false premise implies anything. It differs from the everyday causal 'if', so whether the parts are related doesn't matter, and nothing here is self-referential.
